head: bb4c0e3ddba219c994fddf971198996b45819d79
title: A top-level `import psycopg` stops the whole test module loading under psycopg2.
reason: requirements.txt:37 pins `psycopg[c]==3.3.6`, and unittests/test_async_delete.py:20 already imports from psycopg at the top of the module, so the project uses psycopg 3 and a psycopg2-only setup is not supported.

head: 3c71fe893496207bb5dccc8ebf015c5f7ba0ae1f
title: An unset belief_time may stop the lookup from finding existing annotations, so repeat posts create duplicates.
reason: Line 25 defines `belief_time = db.Column(..., nullable=True)` with no default, so an annotation without a belief time is stored as NULL, and the `== None` filter (rendered as IS NULL) matches the stored row, so no duplicates are created.

head: 3c71fe893496207bb5dccc8ebf015c5f7ba0ae1f

head: 560786c37e3658457a0821b119d322bb767045bc
title: Battery level formula is not clamped to 0–100 %.
reason: Line 39 of packages/features/battery-voltage.yaml already clamps the formula's result to 0–100 with a filter (`std::min(100.0f, std::max(0.0f, x))`) and leaves NaN alone, so the level can't read above 100 % or below 0 %.

head: 92f784b94f218c58d45b481aba4a13723f51e298
title: Local `nativeThreadId` still holds the expired checkpoint's thread ID after it is dropped
reason: The local `nativeThreadId` is only written back to the record in `onAccepted` (conversation.ts:1050), which turn.ts calls from `native.run` (line 113) after `onThread` (line 107) has already replaced it, so a failure before `onThread` never writes the stale ID back.

head: d8682e7a9af21ba8a4ff0946f3716ef442ccaea6
title: The usage insert takes the student only from the assessment instance, which can break group-assessment submissions.
reason: shared-question-usages.sql lines 30-34 resolve the student with `coalesce(ai.user_id, tu.user_id)` through `LEFT JOIN team_users`, and line 58 keeps only rows where `p.user_id IS NOT NULL`, so group assessments add each team member and never insert a NULL user.
